Source: Wikimedia Commons highlight clips from the Wikipedia Usability Initiative's March 2009 "Usability and Experience Study" (https://usability.wikimedia.org/wiki/Usability_and_Experience_Study); clips listed inline; speech transcribed locally with Whisper (mlx large-v3-turbo / faster-whisper small.en), not a published transcript — expect ASR errors, no speaker labels
Licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 (per each file page on Commons; attribution: Wikimedia Foundation)
Description: New/non-editors of English Wikipedia thinking aloud while attempting to edit an article in the 2009 MonoBook editor, with occasional facilitator questions; edited highlight reels of real lab sessions, themed "editing makes me feel stupid", "I can't tell what this looks like", "explain the editing process", plus general first impressions.
